Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1017
Claimant:
Laurie Gonzales
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
28 Nov 2023
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road and said the other vehicle drifted into tehir
lane as they were merging. They stated they were taken to hospital by ambulance with a head injury and were
diagnosed with a concussion.
21 Mar 2024
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The damage pattern along the driver's side is
consistent with the described impact, and the other driver's statement matches the claimant's account in its main
points.
1 Apr 2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone to confirm the sequence of events. They gave the same account as in the first
report and described the impact as a sharp jolt from the right that threw them against the side of the cabin.
7 Apr 2024
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses who saw the vehicles make contact as one was changing
lanes. Both described the same sequence and neither had any connection to the parties involved.
9 Apr 2024
Checked the claimant's medical records supplied with the claim. Tretament included imaging, a period of rest, and
follow-up appointments, and the notes show symptoms easing steadliy over several weeks. No earlier injury to the
same area appears in the records we hold.
8 May 2024
Confirmed with the claimant that the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle was insured under this policy
at the time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage, and no prior
damage to the vehicle is recorded.
17 May 2024
Noted that the claimant was not certain which seat position they occupied at the moment of impact, and recalled
being unsure wehther they had been seated toward the centre or the passenger side. This has been recorded as
stated and does not change the consistency of the rest of the account.
9 Jun 2024
Repair estimate has been received and its line items align with the damage seen in the photos and the reported
impact. Medical and vehicle findings are being progressed for settlement review, and the claim is recommended to
proceed on the current evidence.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
